title: Emerald Tools & More
description: Think emeralds are just for trading? NO! With this mod, you can craft armor and tools from emeralds, as well as emerald apples and mystical mirrors!
body:
### 💎 Emerald Expansion

Think emeralds are only for trading? NO! With this simple mod, you'll get:

### ⚔️ Features:

* **Emerald Equipment**: In terms of stats, it falls between iron and diamond armor. You can apply any patterns to the armor.
* **Horse Armor**: You can now find new horse armor—emerald armor—in desert temples! Its protection level falls between iron and diamond horse armor, with a value of 9.
* **Emerald Apple**: Excellent food! It is crafted from one apple and eight emeralds; eating it restores two hunger shanks and 8.8 saturation points. As a nice bonus, it grants Luck I for 5 minutes, Hero of the Village I for 70 seconds (80% chance), and Regeneration I for 20 seconds (70% chance).
* **Emerald Mirror**: It has 50 durability but cannot be repaired. Pressing Shift + Right-Click on a bed allows the mirror to save that bed's coordinates; you can then teleport to your bed simply by holding the mirror and Right-Clicking. Pressing Shift + Right-Click on the saved bed clears the mirror's memory.
### Cool armor feature
* Residents will offer discounts on goods when wearing a full set of emerald armor.
### 🌍 Multilingual Support:
This mod is fully localized and supports the following languages:
🇷🇺 Russian, 🇬🇧 English, 🇪🇸 Spanish, 🇮🇹 Italian, 🇩🇪 German, 🇫🇷 French, 🇨🇳 Chinese, 🇯🇵 Japanese, 🇰🇷 Korean, 🇧🇷 Portuguese (Brazilian).
### Permissions
* **Modpacks:** You are free to include this mod in any modpack, as long as you provide a link back to this page and credit me as the author.
* **Re-uploading:** Do not re-upload the mod to other websites. 
* **Modifying:** You may not redistribute modified versions of this mod without my permission.
### Versions
* Currently, only Forge 1.20.1 is available. 
* However, in the future, Forge 1.12.2, Forge 1.16.5, NeoForge 1.21.1, NeoForge 1.21.11, and possibly Fabric and Forge 1.7.10 will be supported.
